name: 回春丹
subject: One healing medicine pill on a small folded cream paper wrapper. Large reddish-brown stepped round herbal pill with a clear pale pink cross-shaped impressed groove. Small green leaf tucked under wrapper. Matte medicinal pellet, NOT slime ball, no goo or glow. Big compact silhouette.

name: 聚气丹
subject: One qi-restoring amber ochre alchemical pill, thick stepped round pellet with a single dark red angular spiral pressed into its front. It sits in a small torn red paper cradle. Only broad flat shading blocks, NOT magma cream, no lava or flame.

name: 避毒丹
subject: Two dark forest-green herbal antidote pellets, one large and one small, resting against a folded tan paper medicine packet with a single pale leaf mark. Broad matte green blocks, NOT spider eyes, no eyeballs or slime.

name: 状元酒
subject: One squat ivory ceramic Chinese scholars wine bottle, short narrow neck, red cloth seal tied with a plain gold band, one large dark navy square label with a simple cream brush-stroke symbol (not text). Off-white bottle body, thick stepped shoulders. No clear glass, honey bottle or potion silhouette.

name: 壮行酒
subject: One broad dark brown clay marching wine flask with flat rounded body, short stout neck sealed with a dull red cloth plug, two thick brown cord bands crossing its body and a plain red rectangular patch. Robust soldier travel vessel, visibly different from ivory scholarly bottle. No glass potion or ornate decoration.

name: 安魂香
subject: One short bundle of THREE thick parallel purple-gray incense sticks, held by two broad cream paper bands, top ends each showing a tiny dull orange ember pixel. Plain dark red small knot near base. No flame plume, smoke haze, glow, torch or blaze rod. Clearly a bundled incense consumable.

name: 引路香
subject: One compact olive-brown SPIRAL incense coil seen at slight angle, with a large clear open spiral gap, tiny orange ember at outer end, short pale yellow paper tag tucked at bottom. Broad square step spiral, no background plate, no smoke or glow. Clearly a different incense shape from straight stick bundle.

name: 军粮
subject: One compact military ration packet: two square coarse tan hardtack biscuits partly exposed from a folded dark olive cloth wrapper, thick brown string tied across the lower bundle. Two large dark score marks on biscuit. Practical dried travel food, no bread loaf, no realistic crumb texture, no modern package.
